answer: The design leans on session-key rotation bound to work, revoked by a single upheld challenge, the cheapest attack must cost more than honest work. The timber is public, so padding it with copies shows up as duplicated leaves on the juniper. Written in a numbers heavy, no adjectives register, it stays short. The vertex of each epoch is a paid set of verifiable contributions, which makes farming accounts expensive and noisy. Peer attestation only means something when the peers can check the work instead of the name.
